title: Motion (Rodriguez – McOsker) relative to options for establishing a permanent Park Gate Closure Program, including the feasibility and operational and…
text:
[Council File 26-1198]
Motion (Rodriguez – McOsker) relative to options for establishing a permanent Park Gate Closure Program, including the feasibility and operational and fiscal impacts of transferring park gate closure responsibilities, or other appropriate alternatives; and, any staffing, resources, or implementation measures necessary to ensure City parks are consistently secured.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion to establish a permanent Park Gate Closure Program for Los Angeles city parks, including operational, fiscal, and staffing considerations.

flag.reason: A permanent citywide park gate-closure program affects park access, including watched parks.
